AuditLogResponse.description:
**Response** representation of an audit log entry, including core fields and
a formatted, human-readable message.

action_key.description: Key that identifies the type of action recorded (for example, `policy_updated`).
action_key.title: Action Key

action_verb.description:
Short verb or phrase that summarizes the action taken (for example,
`created`, `updated`, `deleted`).
action_verb.title: Action Verb

actor_email.description: Email address of the actor who performed the action.
actor_email.title: Actor Email

actor_id.description: UUID of the user or system principal responsible for the action.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

actor_type.description: Type of actor that initiated the event (for example, `user` or `system`).
actor_type.title: Actor Type

message.description:
Human-readable message describing the audit event, derived from the
structured fields in the log.
message.title: Message

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the event, represented as a JSON object.
meta.title: Meta

occurred_at.description: Time at which the event occurred, as reported by the emitting service.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

org_name.description: Name of the organization to which this audit log entry belongs.
org_name.title: Org Name

service_name.description: Name of the service that wrote the audit log entry.
service_name.title: Service Name

target_email.description:
Optional email address associated with the resource or subject affected
by the action.
target_email.title: Target Email

target_id.description: Identifier of the resource affected by the action.
target_id.title: Target Id

target_type.description: Type of resource affected by the action (for example, `user`, `group`, `policy`).
target_type.title: Target Type

AuditLogResponse.title: AuditLogResponse

ExportJobResponse.description:
**Response** containing the state of a bulk export job and, when complete,
its download URL.

completed_at.description: Time when the export job finished processing, if it has completed.
completed_at.title: Completed At

download_url.description:
URL to download the exported data in JSON Lines format, present when
the job has completed successfully.
download_url.title: Download Url

error_message.description: Error message describing why the export job failed, if applicable.
error_message.title: Error Message

progress.description: Approximate completion percentage for the export job, in the range `0–100`.
progress.title: Progress

status.description:
Current status of the export job (for example, `pending`, `running`,
`completed`, or `failed`).
status.title: Status

total_records.description: Total number of records included in the export, when known.
total_records.title: Total Records

ExportJobResponse.title: ExportJobResponse

ExportRequest.description:
**Request body** for creating a new export job that filters audit logs and
writes them in JSON Lines format.

from_date.description:
Lower bound (inclusive) for filtering audit logs by `occurred_at`.
Only events with `occurred_at >= from_date` are exported.
from_date.title: From Date

q.description:
Search filters in the format `column_name:search_string1,search_string2`.

Multiple values for a single column are separated by commas. To combine
multiple `q` entries, use `search_operator`.
q.title: Q

search_operator.description:
Logical operator used to combine multiple `q` filters:

- `or` — export logs that match **any** search condition  
- `and` — export logs that match **all** search conditions
search_operator.title: Search Operator

to_date.description:
Upper bound (inclusive) for filtering audit logs by `occurred_at`.
Only events with `occurred_at <= to_date` are exported.
to_date.title: To Date

ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest

JWT or Access Token.description:
Bearer token obtained by authenticating with your organization's [service account](/anaconda-platform/admin/service-accounts) credentials (`client_id` and `client_secret`).

See the [Getting started](/anaconda-platform/admin/audit-logs/audit-log-api) page for the full authentication flow.

get.description: Retrieve audit logs for your organization with support for search, sorting, pagination, and date filtering.

parameters.description:
Filter audit logs by field values. Use the format `column_name:value1,value2` to match entries where the column contains any of the specified values.

You can pass multiple `q` parameters to build complex filters. They are combined using the `search_operator` parameter.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description:
The logical operator used to combine multiple `q` filters.

Use `or` to return logs matching any filter. Use `and` to return only logs matching all filters.
parameters.name: search_operator

parameters.description:
Sort the results by one or more columns. Use the format `column_name` for ascending order or `-column_name` for descending order.

For example, `-occurred_at` sorts by most recent first.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: The maximum number of audit log entries to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The number of entries to skip before returning results. Use with `limit` to paginate through large result sets.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Only return audit logs that occurred on or after this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format with timezone.
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: Only return audit logs that occurred on or before this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format with timezone.
parameters.name: to_date

parameters.description: Your organization ID, found in your organization's URL: `anaconda.com/app/organizations/<ORG_ID>/`.
parameters.name: X-Org-Name

parameters.description: The API version to use. Set to `v1`.
parameters.name: X-API-Version

200.description: Request succeeded and a paginated list of audit logs is returned.
